name: com.litwin.unityflow
description: YAML-driven UI and gameplay test runner for the Unity Editor. Write a .flow.yaml, run one command, and the Editor drives your game and reports structured pass/fail. Designed so both humans and AI agents can author tests without writing C#.

samples.description: Runnable .flow.yaml examples covering tapOn, waitFor, assertions and screenshots.
A small top-down game built from primitives, with six flows that drive it end to end: menu form, keyboard-only navigation, gameplay, drag-to-reorder, pause, and one deliberate failure.
